capabilities: scan a vault to compute yearly writing stats
resolve note creation dates from frontmatter or file times
detect writing archetypes like Journaler or Zettelkasten Architect
generate themed wrapped cards with charts and streaks
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian provides no built-in yearly summary of your writing activity or shareable stats cards.

relations.evidence: A Spotify Wrapped-style look at your year in Obsidian.

summary: Year-in-review generator that scans a vault and produces shareable wrapped cards of writing stats, rhythm, and archetypes.
